narrative.overview:
Relay is an Operate product: a compact, record-first workspace where company material becomes reviewable context, campaign intent, browser conversations, and accountable follow-through. The visual system stays quiet so the current record, its evidence, and the next operator decision remain easy to scan. DM Sans, white and cool lilac-gray surfaces, indigo state emphasis, and Lucide icons are the incumbent identity.

The v5/v6 surfaces extend that same desk across the complete loop. Company brain has Business model, Source intake, and Ask company brain tabs. The business-model workbench keeps offerings and signals separate, shows exact source quotes, preserves approved clarification history, and counts only unanswered founder questions. Campaign briefing proceeds in a visible order: approved offering, campaign description and goal, purpose and channel, selected audience, explicit AI assistance, then operator review before a plan is generated. The plan describes planned fields; collected answers and quotes live in campaign conversations and offering results.

The agent and conversation surfaces keep control and evidence explicit. In-call Actions, natural-language revision proposals with before/after diffs, and viewer read-only states sit beside the voice workbench. Saved Conversations expose server action receipts, browser-only diagnostics, refusal and uncertainty guards, and source-linked learning. Team and invitation states, Join workspace account mismatch, WhatsApp setup and Inbox scope, and Automations' local worker heartbeat all use the same candid operational language. These are extensions of the existing world, not a new visual concept.

rules.name: The State Before Decoration Rule
rules.body: Use indigo, green, rose, and small motion to explain location, action, or record state. Do not introduce color as a quality claim.

rules.name: The Record Readability Rule
rules.body: Keep operational copy at 12–13px with 1.5 line height; use smaller type for metadata only when its supporting label remains clear.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Keep containers flat at rest. Use a border, wash, or one small transient shadow to establish hierarchy; never use elevation to imply confidence or model quality.

dos: Do keep Company brain tabs, source quotes, offering/signal status, approved clarification history, and unanswered counts visible where the decision is made.
Do make AI assistance an explicit step and place its suggestions before the fields they populate; require review before a plan or revision is applied.
Do label plan fields as planned schema and link collected evidence to conversations or offering results.
Do show server receipts, browser-only diagnostics, refusal guards, worker heartbeat, team access state, and connection scope in plain language.
Do preserve the shared page frame, DM Sans hierarchy, indigo state language, and the 820px drawer / 580px compact behavior.
Do keep CSV mapping collapsed before row review, recheck typed campaign answers against their receipt, and link each post-call learning job to the exact conversation.
Do keep public identity anonymous, source-backed, and explicit about Start-before-transcript and session/turn limits.
donts: Don't present an approved clarification as an unanswered founder task.
Don't place the full offering evidence table ahead of the company decision path; keep it behind the collapsed results disclosure.
Don't render `Not collected` as a live status in a planned campaign schema.

Don't treat available integrations, WhatsApp setup, worker heartbeat, provider acceptance, browser receipt time, or selected contact context as proof of connection, delivery, audible latency, identity, or customer intent.
Don't allow viewer accounts to mutate, approve, revise, test, send, or create actions; keep their records readable and their limitations explicit.
Don't claim cloud execution, channel delivery, or audio quality from a configured setting, a paused/local-only worker, or a browser receipt.
Don't turn version history, action diagnostics, prompt diffs, execution history, or Personal Voice enrollment into competing editor columns. Keep them collapsible and attributable.
